properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 8 at 11:01AM CDT until September 9 at 8:20PM CDT by NWS Lake Charles LA
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in Texas...

Pine Island Bayou Near Sour Lake affecting Hardin and Jefferson
Counties.

...The Flood Warning is cancelled for the following rivers in
Texas...

Neches River at Neches River Saltwater Barrier affecting Hardin,
Jasper, Orange and Jefferson Counties.

For the Pine Island Bayou...including Sour Lake...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Pine Island Bayou near Sour Lake.

* WHEN...Until Wednesday evening.

* IMPACTS...At 25.0 feet, Water inundates roads in lowland areas near
the river. Low spots on Old Sour Lake Road are under water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 10:45 AM CDT Tuesday the stage was 26.7 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 22.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 10:45 AM CDT Tuesday was 27.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage
tomorrow morning and continue falling to 19.4 feet Sunday
morning.
- Flood stage is 25.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 26.7
feet on 04/24/1977.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this afternoon at 1215 PM CDT.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 8 at 9:19PM CDT until September 9 at 12:30AM CDT by NWS Des Moines IA
properties.description:
At 919 PM CDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
thunderstorms, which had produced heavy rainfall between 1 and 3
inches across much of the warned area. Polk County public safety
agencies report that any poor drainage and low lying flooding has
ended. However, with additional storms likely moving over the area
through the rest of this evening, additional rainfall up to 1.5
inches is possible and may renew flooding in these poor drainage and
low lying areas.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Des Moines, West Des Moines, Ankeny, Urbandale, Johnston, Clive,
Altoona, Pleasant Hill, Grimes, Windsor Heights, Carlisle,
Bondurant, Polk City, Saylorville, Mitchellville, Adventureland
Amusement Park, Iowa State Fairgrounds and Prairie Meadows.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

For the latest stream observations and forecasts refer to
weather.gov/desmoines/water.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 8 at 9:07PM CDT until September 8 at 10:15PM CDT by NWS Quad Cities IA IL
properties.description:
SVRDVN

The National Weather Service in the Quad Cities has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Cedar County in east central Iowa...
Eastern Johnson County in east central Iowa...
Jones County in east central Iowa...
Northwestern Muscatine County in east central Iowa...
Southern Linn County in east central Iowa...

* Until 1015 PM CDT.

* At 907 PM CDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from Cedar Rapids to Twin View Heights to near Sharon
Center, moving east at 40 mph.

HAZARD...70 mph wind gusts and nickel size hail.

SOURCE...Trained weather spotters.

IMPACT...Expect considerable tree damage. Damage is likely to
mobile homes, roofs, and outbuildings.

* Locations impacted include...
Cedar Rapids, Iowa City, Anamosa, Tipton, West Branch,
Mechanicsville, Stanwood, Marion, Coralville, Hiawatha, Mount
Vernon, West Liberty, Lisbon, Solon, Ely, Springville, University
Heights, Lowden, Hills, and Olin.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 80 in Iowa between mile markers 242 and 276.
Interstate 380 between mile markers 17 and 24.
properties.instruction:
Remain alert for a possible tornado! Tornadoes can develop quickly
from severe thunderstorms. If you spot a tornado go at once into the
basement or small central room in a sturdy structure.

For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
sturdy building.

Continuous cloud to ground lightning is occurring with these storms.
Move indoors immediately. Lightning is one of nature's leading
killers. Remember, if you can hear thunder, you are close enough to
be struck by lightning.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with these storms, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.
